authenticity.title: Authentic Heritage, Legally Protected Origin
authenticity.desc: Rooted in a 900-year leathercraft tradition, authentic Kolhapuri footwear was granted India's Geographical Indication (GI) tag in 2019, legally certifying its origin across eight designated districts in Maharashtra and Karnataka. Every authentic pair in our catalogue is sourced directly from skilled artisan families in Kolhapur, preserving traditional hand-stitched bag-tanned leather methods rather than mass-produced imitations.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Practical answers to common queries from international buyers, boutiques, and retailers.
faq.a1: We export handcrafted genuine leather goods and footwear across our catalogue, including Leather Jackets, Laptop Bags, Wallets, Belts, Loafers, Hats, and authentic Kolhapuri Chappals.
faq.q2: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a2: We discuss payment terms directly based on order size, freight mode, and destination country. Please message us on WhatsApp or email to confirm suitable options for your jurisdiction.
faq.q3: Do you handle export documentation and customs clearance?
faq.a3: We provide standard commercial export documentation—including commercial invoices, packing lists, and certificate of origin assistance where applicable—and guide international buyers through standard shipping clearance.
faq.q4: What countries do you ship to?
faq.a4: We ship worldwide through reputable international courier and air cargo partners. Reach out with your delivery city and postal code to confirm transit feasibility, timelines, and shipping rates.
faq.q5: Do you offer private labeling or custom branding?
faq.a5: Custom branding, debossing, and tailored packaging options are available on request for qualifying order sizes. Let us discuss your specific assortment, volume, and branding requirements.
faq.q6: Is there a minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
faq.a6: There is no minimum order quantity for sample requests or retail evaluations. Bulk wholesale volumes, customized batches, and container-scale shipments are discussed and planned per order.
